country: Territory of New Caledonia and Dependencies

fields.climate: tropical; modified by southeast trade winds; hot, humid
fields.hazards: cyclones, most frequent from November to March; volcanism: Matthew and Hunter Islands are historically active
fields.resources: nickel, chrome, iron, cobalt, manganese, silver, gold, lead, copper
fields.farm: coconuts, vegetables, fruits, pork, beef, maize, eggs, bananas, yams, oranges
fields.exports: iron alloys, nickel, nickel ore, processed crustaceans, shellfish

system.text: parliamentary democracy (Territorial Congress); an overseas collectivity of France

fields.legal: civil law system based on French civil law
